description: This file defines the class ReportGeneratorDao, which provides data access methods for handling report-related entities in the OrangeHRM HRM system, including retrieving, saving, and deleting report data, as well as searching reports with filters.

classes.name: ReportGeneratorDao
classes.description: Data Access Object for Report entities, providing methods to retrieve, save, delete, and search reports and associated entities within the OrangeHRM system.

methods.name: getSelectedDisplayFieldsByReportId
methods.description: Retrieves selected display fields associated with a specific report ID.

methods.name: getSelectedDisplayFieldGroupIdsByReportId
methods.description: Retrieves IDs of selected display field groups associated with a specific report ID.

methods.name: getSelectedCompositeDisplayFieldsByReportId
methods.description: Retrieves composite display fields associated with a specific report ID.

methods.name: getSelectedFilterFieldsByReportId
methods.description: Retrieves filter fields selected for a specific report ID.

methods.name: getReport
methods.description: Fetches a report entity by its ID.

methods.name: getSummaryDisplayFieldByReportId
methods.description: Retrieves summary display fields associated with a specific report ID.

methods.name: saveReport
methods.description: Saves or updates a report along with its associated display field groups, display fields, and filter fields within a transaction.

methods.name: saveSelectedFilterField
methods.description: Persists an array of selected filter fields to the database.

methods.name: saveSelectedDisplayField
methods.description: Persists selected display fields for a report.

methods.name: saveSelectedDisplayFieldGroup
methods.description: Persists selected display field groups for a report.

methods.name: getFilterFieldByName
methods.description: Retrieves a filter field entity by its name.

methods.name: searchPimDefinedReports
methods.description: Searches for reports defined for PIM, based on the provided search filter parameters.

methods.name: getSearchPimDefinedReportsPaginator
methods.description: Creates a paginator object for searching PIM reports with sorting and filters.

methods.name: getSearchPimDefinedReportCount
methods.description: Returns the count of PIM reports matching the search filters.

methods.name: deletePimDefinedReport
methods.description: Deletes a list of reports by their IDs within the PIM report group.

methods.name: getReportById
methods.description: Retrieves a report by its ID.

methods.name: getExistingReportIdsForPim
methods.description: Fetches existing report IDs for the PIM report group, matching a list of IDs.

methods.name: getReportGroupByName
methods.description: Retrieves a report group entity by its name.

methods.name: deleteExistingReportRecordsByReportId
methods.description: Deletes existing report-related records (filter fields, display fields, groups) for a specific report.

methods.name: deleteSelectedDisplayFieldGroups
methods.description: Deletes selected display field groups for a specific report.

methods.name: deleteSelectedDisplayFields
methods.description: Deletes selected display fields for a specific report.

methods.name: deleteSelectedFilterFields
methods.description: Deletes selected filter fields for a specific report.

methods.name: getSelectedDisplayFieldIdsByReportId
methods.description: Gets IDs of display fields selected for a report.

methods.name: getSelectedDisplayFieldIdsByReportGroupId
methods.description: Gets IDs of display fields grouped under a specific display field group for a report.

methods.name: getIncludeType
methods.description: Retrieves a specific 'include' filter field selected for a report.

methods.name: isIncludeHeader
methods.description: Checks if a display field group is marked as header for a specific report ID.

methods.name: getDisplayFieldGroupIdList
methods.description: Gets list of display field group IDs associated with a report.

methods.name: getSkippedSelectedFilterFieldsByReportId
methods.description: Retrieves filter fields that are skipped (not in order 1) for a report.

methods.name: getAllDisplayFieldGroups
methods.description: Fetches all display field groups.

methods.name: getAllDisplayFields
methods.description: Fetches all display fields that are associated with a display field group.

methods.name: getAllFilterFields
methods.description: Fetches all filter fields belonging to the 'pim' report group, excluding the 'include' filter.
